protocol:
1.  Pipette a clear liquid into the wells of a blue 96-well plate using a micropipette.
2.  Transfer a reagent from a microcentrifuge tube, stored on ice in a green container, into the wells of a pink 96-well plate.
3.  Pipette a reagent into the wells of a white 96-well plate.
4.  Open the lid of a BIO-RAD T100 Thermal Cycler.
5.  Place the prepared PCR tubes into the sample block of the thermal cycler.
6.  Close the lid of the thermal cycler.
7.  Operate the touchscreen of the BIO-RAD T100 Thermal Cycler to run a program.
